new_entities.name: Gabapentin enacarbil for restless legs syndrome
aliases: gabapentin enacarbil in restless legs syndrome
new_entities.description: Use of gabapentin enacarbil to reduce symptom burden in adults with moderate to severe restless legs syndrome.

new_entities.name: Disease severity
new_entities.description: Overall severity of a disorder, often measured by validated symptom scales such as the International Restless Legs Scale.

edges.effect_quant: Gabapentin enacarbil consistently lowers RLS severity scores. A 2026 dose-response network meta-analysis pooled 15 studies and 2,885 participants, while pivotal placebo-controlled trials showed placebo-adjusted IRLS improvements of -3.5 points at 1,200 mg and relapse rates of 9/96 on continued therapy versus 22/97 after placebo withdrawal.
edges.population: adults with moderate to severe primary restless legs syndrome, especially patients with daily or near-daily symptoms
edges.mechanism: As a prodrug of gabapentin, gabapentin enacarbil modulates alpha-2-delta calcium-channel signaling and dampens the sensory discomfort and sleep-disrupting urges that define restless legs syndrome.
edges.summary: This is a good protective severity edge. The efficacy signal is replicated across dose-ranging, phase 3, and randomized-withdrawal designs, which supports durability beyond a brief placebo response.
edges.caveats: Sedation and dizziness are meaningful tradeoffs, and gabapentin enacarbil is best understood as symptom management rather than cure. Head-to-head comparisons suggest broadly similar efficacy to other first-line non-dopaminergic options rather than clear superiority.

evidence.notes: Benefit-risk comparison of gabapentin enacarbil versus pregabalin for restless legs syndrome: A dose-response model-based network meta-analysis.

evidence.citation: KushidaCA et al 2011 Mayo Clin Proc
evidence.notes: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study to assess the efficacy and tolerability of gabapentin enacarbil in subjects with restless legs syndrome.

effect_quant.comparator: International Restless Legs Scale change with gabapentin enacarbil 1,200 mg versus placebo at week 12

evidence.citation: BoganRK et al 2010 Mayo Clin Proc
evidence.notes: Long-term maintenance treatment of restless legs syndrome with gabapentin enacarbil: a randomized controlled study.

effect_quant.comparator: relapse with continued gabapentin enacarbil versus placebo withdrawal during the randomized maintenance phase
